text: Reliability as a Teammate published at AIED 2026; Grounded Teacher published in IJCV.
Joined ETH SCAI Lab as a Research Assistant.

Our team SCAI-ropractors won Track 2 of the ASIA 2026 Data Challenge. I received a travel grant and presented our winning work at the ASIA Annual Scientific Meeting in San Antonio, Texas, on 24 April 2026.
Started my M.Sc. in Computer Science at ETH Zürich.
